status_note: ALL entries are status=draft / approved=false. The engine loads ONLY status=published AND approved=true, so nothing here is served to a customer until the brand fills the «...» facts and promotes it into approved_kb.json. Questions/keywords are from chat research and VERIFIED against classify_v2. answer_mode=self_answer_candidate means the engine can auto-answer it once approved; human_assist means it routes to a person and the draft just speeds the human reply.

excluded_from_self_answer.note: Never given self-answer FAQ - always human, because a wrong answer is harmful or binding.
excluded_from_self_answer.I03: แพ้/เจ/ฮาลาล/วีแกน/โลหะหนัก/เบาหวาน - personal safety + formal product claim (H2).
excluded_from_self_answer.I07: ขายส่ง/ราคาส่ง/ขั้นต่ำ - commercial terms (Sales/H2).
excluded_from_self_answer.I14: ร้องเรียนคุณภาพ/สินค้าเสีย - complaint + possible claim (H2).
